title: Services give a stable route
summary: A Service gives a stable way to reach a selected group of Pods. This example is internal to the cluster.
introduction: A Service gives a stable way to reach a selected group of Pods. This example is internal to the cluster. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain services give a stable route
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Service gives a stable way to reach a selected group of Pods. This example is internal to the cluster.

blocks.code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: club-web
spec:
  selector:
    app: club-web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
  type: ClusterIP
blocks.title: Services give a stable route

blocks.text: The Service selects Pods labelled app=club-web and forwards traffic to their port 80. It does not create a public cloud load balancer.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare the selector with the Deployment labels.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A Service with no matching healthy Pods cannot serve the app.
For more detail later, use this [Kubernetes further reading](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tutorials/kubernetes-basics/).
